source_contract: Requested px is quarter-fit by0.25; actual FreeType pixel size=Python round(px*4), so quartersteps select integer4x font sizes. Use fresh hinted masks at each size, not resized rasteratlas.

getmetrics gives integer ascender/descender at selectedfontsize; cap=-font.getbbox(H,anchor=ls).top. Source canvas base=pad+asc, ch=asc+desc+2pad, cw=int(sumadv-tracking+2pad). Noto ExtraBold24 hasasc26/desc8/cap18; at77 has83/23/cap55. Native Em-based scaling cannot substitute.

measure uses whole font.getlength(text) perrun, even when tracking nonzero; text_layer advances percharacter getlength(character)+tracking when tracking!=0, otherwise draws/shapes whole run. Thus measure and actual cursor can differ undertracking duekerning. Preserve source perrunfit measurement separately from trackedrendercursor; do not silently use summednativeglyphwidths for both.

Zero tracking whole run retains RAQM kerning, ligatures, combining marks and script shaping. Nonzero tracking source intentionally calls Draw.text separately for each Unicodecharacter; do not reinterpret it as properclustertracking or globalshaping plusspacing. Preserve Unicode data, defaultbidi and .notdef; no ASCII restriction/normalization.

ImageDraw separates integer coordinate using truncation towardzero and signedfraction; getmask2 receives start narrowed to Cfloat. _imagingft width/height+=ceil(start); first pass findsbitmapleft/top; second origin=Cround((-left+startX)*64),Cround((-top-startY)*64); glyphpositions use PIXEL(v)=((v+32)&-64)>>6. This is not ties-even or FT_Set_Transform subpixelhinting. Source bboxls/ascender bearing and actualbitmapextents must not be conflated.

Supersampled glyphcoverage and straightRGBA colorcanvas are independently drawn in original text_layer. The existing common orderedstroke/EDTnearest-color/quantization/LANCZOS/area pipeline follows these initial planes; do not reimplement it forTTF.
